'''Docking Bay 73''', also known as '''Hangar 73''', was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in the [[Mos Ila Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="On the Run" />

==Behind the scenes==
Docking Bay 73 first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

In the mission "On the Run" on Tatooine, the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group known as [[Raal's Regulators]] are hunting [[Jemala Ha'rangir]], a [[Hidden Chain]] [[Desertion/Legends|defector]]. If the player is affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Regulators' ship, the ''[[Mercenary's Honor]]'', will dock at the bay. However, if the player is affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the ship will be docked at [[Docking Bay 28]] in the [[Anchorhead Spaceport]] instead.<ref name="On the Run" />
